description: Speech to text / transcribe audio / ASR with Whisper large-v3-turbo: give an audio URL (or base64) of WAV, MP3, FLAC, OGG, M4A or WebM (up to 20 min / 10 MB) and get the transcript, detected language, timed segments and WebVTT subtitles. task=translate returns English text from any language. $0.002 USDC per started minute on Base via x402; the quote is computed from the file duration before payment; failures are not charged. Price: $0.002 per started audio minute. First call returns the x402 PaymentRequired (no charge); retry with payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

audio_base64.description: Base64 audio (max ~1 MB via MCP; use audio_url or the REST endpoint for larger files)

audio_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the audio file (max 10 MB, 20 min). Preferred.

requestKey.description: Optional idempotency key: same payer + requestKey + input returns the stored result without a second charge (7 days).

x402_payment.description: Optional. Base64 x402 v2 PaymentPayload, for clients that cannot set params._meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to get the exact price.
